Install CMake, point it at the opencv folder, set the binary output to opencv/bin.

Click configure.

Find OPENCV_EXTRA_MODULES_PATH and set it to the modules path under opencv_contrib.

Under BUILD, find BUILD_WORLD and ensure it's ticked.

Click Generate.

Open the project file and build Release.

Find CMakeTargets\INSTALL that appears as a project in Visual Studio and Build it. This will generate the headers.
